| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load | Server-side prerendering (SSR) |
| Snappy after load | WebAssembly client-side interactivity |
| Worldwide users/latency | WASM runs locally — no server round-trips for UI |
| Interactive controls | `@rendermode InteractiveWebAssembly` on all pages |
| Authentication | ASP.NET Core Identity (Individual Accounts) |

**Key files:**
- `ShipmentTracker/` — Server project (API, Identity, DB, prerendering)
- `ShipmentTracker.Client/Pages/Dispatcher.razor` — Dispatcher dashboard (list/filter/create/update)
- `ShipmentTracker.Client/Pages/TrackShipment.razor` — Customer tracking page
- `ShipmentTracker/ShipmentEndpoints.cs` — Minimal API for shipments
- `ShipmentTracker/Data/Shipment.cs` — Domain model with seed data

**Run with:** `cd ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker && dotnet run`
